F-15 Eagle exterior model
Source https://www.innerscene.com/tools/library/3d-parts/f-15-eagle-fighter-jet-e1d11142
Author Innerscene. License CC0. Downloaded 2026-11-09.
The author describes this as an original F-15 style model. It is not an official manufacturer model.
The game uses an approximate independent flight configuration and its existing fighter cockpit.
GLTFLoader and BufferGeometryUtils are from Three.js r160, MIT license, covered by ../THREE-LICENSE.txt.

Airbus A220-300 and A380-800, Cessna 172P, Diamond DA42
Source https://github.com/stagworksde/skytrails-aircraft-models/releases/tag/v0.1.0
FlightGear contributors and Skytrails. GPL-2.0-only. The original authors
and conversion notices are included in each unmodified GLB and in the source archive.
Corresponding source: skytrails-source.zip. License: SKYTRAILS-COPYING.txt.
The game positions these low-poly traffic exteriors at runtime and uses its
own cockpit and landing gear. The C172P exterior represents the SB-172 family.

Boeing 777-300ER (b773 High-Fidelity Reference Airframe)
Replaced the legacy low-poly Skytrails ac_b77w external traffic GLB with an
in-game procedural reference airframe, 3-4-3 widebody cabin, articulated 6-wheel
bogie landing gear, GE90-115B translating reversers, and 6-LCD flight deck in
dist/b773-highdef.js (original simulator code, MIT/repo license; axes +X right,
+Y up, -Z forward; units in meters). Reference aircraft dimensions: Boeing 777-200LR/
-300ER Airport Planning Manual (ACAP, https://www.boeing.com/commercial/airports/plan-manuals).

Boeing 747-8F (sf748), F-16C/F-16V (sf16/f16v), and Antonov An-124-100 (an124)
Original in-game procedural airframes, articulated mechanisms, and aircraft-specific
flight decks implemented in dist/b748f-highdef.js, dist/f16-highdef.js, and
dist/an124-highdef.js (MIT/repo license; axes +X right, +Y up, -Z forward; meters).
Reference dimensions, outlines, and configurations:
- https://www.boeing.com/content/dam/boeing/v2/airports/acaps/747-400_Rev_F.pdf
- https://www.boeing.com/commercial/airports/plan-manuals
- https://www.lockheedmartin.com/content/dam/lockheed-martin/aero/documents/F-16/25-00470_F-16%20Block70_72_Product%20Card_Jan%202025.pdf
- https://www.af.mil/About-Us/Fact-Sheets/Display/Article/104505/f-16-fighting-falcon/
- https://www.antonov.com/en/history/an-124-ruslan
- https://antonov-airlines.aero/methods/optg120
Manufacturer/copyrighted reference assets are not redistributed; flight dynamics
and cockpit avionics represent simulator implementations for gameplay.

AgustaWestland AW101 Merlin Helicopter
Source https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/helicopter-ef70283b1dea4ae8b18eec9231ce390e via https://github.com/srcejon/sdrangel-3d-models
Author Gigantic Burger (https://sketchfab.com/gigantic.burger). License CC-BY-4.0 (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
The game adapts this model for high-resolution exterior rendering with dynamic main and tail rotors.
